full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted a suit for partition of the suit property in the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Barguna, being Partition Suit No. 42 of 1988, alleging, inter alia, that the suit land originally belonged to Asmat Ali; that by a registered deed of Wakf Asmat Ali gifted the suit property to Asmat Ali Madrasha by a registered instrument dated 8-3-1927 that Asmat Ali himself became the first Motwalli of the Wakf Estate and managed the affairs of the Wakf and on his death the plaintiff and defendant No. 5 became joint Mutwallis and they are managing the affairs of the Wakf Estate; that defendant No. 1 in violation of the trust is trying to grab the Wakf property; that the plaintiff recently learnt that on 4-5-1986 defendant No.5 illegally executed and registered a deed of nadabi patra dated 29-4-1986 in favour of his relations defendant Nos. 1-3 in respect of 8 annas share in SA Khatian No.46 and 1207 without prior permission from the Administrator of Wakf; that defendant Nos. 1-3 do not own and possess any land on the basis of the alleged nadabi-patra deed and the Wakf Estate is in possession of the same; that the plaintiff demanded amicable partition of the land described in schedule ''Ka'' to the plaint but the defendants refused and hence the suit.
